findings.problem: Focus item 3. The DC supplemental-wage rule rests only on US-DCP52-002 (FR-230 2018, status historical) and is labelled 'historical source, not confirmed in force'. My judgement on the law: the rule is not wrong as current law. D.C. Code 47-1812.08(b)(1) (US-DCS5-025, A.1, local copy DC_code-47-1812.08_2026-11-02.html, read in full) prescribes one percentage or table method for all 'wages' and no flat supplemental rate ('supplement', 'bonus' and 'commission' do not occur in the section). The defect is the source and the label. The WTC gives the developer no in-force basis for DC supplemental withholding. The 'bonuses and commissions are wages' half has no current source in the register: 47-1801.04 (definition of wages) is not registered.
findings.expected: WTC D381: 'No flat supplemental rate: supplemental payments are withheld with the employer's regular method under D.C. Code 47-1812.08(b)(1) [US-DCS5-025]', in force, with no historical label. Cite the bonus/commission inclusion to the registered DC definition of wages once the source-hunter adds it, or drop it. Retire US-DCP52-002 from WTC/country_specific.
